1) What’s your email address (used for the purchase)?  
2) What is your order ID (e.g., `#W0000000`)?  
3) For the exchange: you mentioned **item ID 4107812777** is the **new** shoe you want—what is the **item ID of the pair you received** that you want to exchange (the current item ID from your order)?

Once I have those, I’ll check that the order is **delivered** and then we can proceed using your **gift card** if any price difference applies.

I actually don’t remember the email I used for the purchase, sorry. Is there another way you can look up my order? I do live in Denver, zip code 80280, if that helps. 

As for the order ID, I’m not sure where to find it right now. Would you be able to look it up with my name and address? My name is Ethan Garcia.

And yes, 4107812777 is the new shoe I want. I’m not sure about the item ID of the pair I received—can you check that for me based on my order? I’m not too familiar with how these IDs work.
